sentences.text: You can smell the linseed oil before you even round the corner into the armor gallery. Under the fluorescent lights, fresh olive paint on the fenders looks nothing like the faded photographs mounted beside them. Every Saturday she polished the same stretch of track link, and every Saturday the same veteran stopped to tell her about El Alamein. The volunteer coaxed decades of grime from a Sherman's drive sprocket with a toothbrush and a rag that used to be his shirt. Between school tours, a curator knelt beside the drive wheel, comparing its casting marks against a wartime factory ledger. Three placards, one battle, zero agreement on how many vehicles actually crossed the ridge at dawn. By closing time the docents had answered the same question about the Tiger's fuel consumption at least a dozen times. Nobody warns you how loud the gallery gets when a hundred eighth-graders discover the periscope viewer actually works. Grandpa just stood there in front of the Sherman, hat in his hands, not saying a word. Somewhere behind the Ardennes diorama, a radio loops scratchy period broadcasts at a volume only the security guard seems to notice. I spent my entire lunch break reading about the Battle of Cambrai and never made it past the first exhibit case. "See that gouge below the turret? Shrapnel," the guide said, tapping the placard with his pen. Why does the Tiger's glacis plate draw crowds while the ambulance half-track beside it sits ignored? Next month the wing will close for a week so riggers can lower the restored turret back onto its race. Honestly, the placard about Kursk gets more foot traffic than the armor itself, which drives the restoration team a little crazy. Did you know this Panzer IV's turret still turns by hand crank if two docents lean into it together? Per the loan agreement with the regimental association, the Churchill's hatches remain sealed and its interior off-limits to photography. Kids press their palms flat against the cold hull until a docent, smiling, taps the no-touching sign for the hundredth time today. Conservators applied a microcrystalline wax to the turret ring, sealing bare steel against the humidity that seeps in whenever the loading dock opens. Disassembled, blasted, primed, and rehung — the suspension bogies came back together in under a week, a crew record. Clients receive a laminated card after each visit noting water parameters, livestock condition, and any recommended equipment upgrades. What is the meaning of the word tank?
